summary: Approve exact 30s SDK-free `mori-core` ordinary test command and temporary `cwd`/`CARGO_HOME`/`CARGO_TARGET_DIR` isolation design as an ordinary non-author source/design reviewer (`doctorwatson-ordinary-core-execution-ordinary-20261018-a1-whole-review`). The selected package and target flags (`-p mori-core --no-default-features --test continuations --test financial_pair --frozen -j1 -- --test-threads=1`) isolate an SDK-free dependency and source call chain (`mori-core` -> `mori-lexer` -> `mori-diagnostics` -> `mori-span` plus pure crates.io dependencies) with no Midnight SDK/ledger/proof crates enabled or reachable. The temporary directory hierarchy, ancestor config existence checks, whitelisted environment dictionary, and symlinked public `registry`/`git` stores match Cargo's documented configuration lookup and `CARGO_HOME` cache structure, subject to the explicit execution conditions and Opus's separate security classification/admission.
findings: SDK-Free Selected Dependency Graph: In candidate/crates/mori-core/Cargo.toml, Midnight crates (midnight-base-crypto, midnight-serialize) are optional dependencies gated solely behind the non-default feature `midnight-compat-tests`. Passing `-p mori-core --no-default-features --test continuations --test financial_pair` excludes both optional dependencies, excludes all SDK-bearing workspace members (`mori`, `mori-backend`, `mori-ledger`), and compiles `mori-core` library without `--cfg test` (excluding the `#[cfg(test)]` `sherlock_draft*` modules). The resulting transitive closure in `candidate/Cargo.lock` consists strictly of workspace crates `mori-core`, `mori-lexer`, `mori-diagnostics` (default features), and `mori-span`, plus standard crates.io packages (`serde`, `serde_json`, `thiserror`, `sha2`, `k256`, `soa-rs`, `miette`, `proptest` and their pure crates.io transitive dependencies) with zero `midnight-*` or `blst` packages reachable.

Public Source Call Chain & Test Target Verification: Both integration test targets (`tests/continuations.rs` with 5 tests and `tests/financial_pair.rs` with 2 tests) embed their `.mori` and `.json` fixtures at compile time via `include_str!` and execute purely in-memory deterministic functions (`mori_core::{parse, validate, simulate, simulate_metered}` and `mori_core::stage::{load, start, resume}` -> `mori_lexer::{lex, decode_string}`). All loops and structures are statically bounded (`MAX_SOURCE_BYTES = 65536`, `MAX_TOKENS = 8192`, `MAX_DECLARATIONS = 256`, `MAX_STATEMENTS = 1024`, `MAX_EXPRESSIONS = 8192`, `MAX_AWAITS_PER_ACTION = 16`, `MAX_TRACE_CELLS = 65536`), performing no runtime file I/O, network I/O, or subprocess spawning.

Financial-Pair & Continuation Oracle Alignment: Tracing `installment-invoice.mori` (`collect`) and `conditional-reserve.mori` (`allocate`) through `parser.rs` and `runtime.rs` confirms exact agreement with `financial-and-work.json` and `mori-tests.json` (12 statements / 42 logical units per `collect` call across linked first and final scenarios; 15 statements / 45 logical units for multi-asset `allocate`, with `register()` supplying the source-fixed liability identity for `"allocation"`). Tracing `escrow.mori` and `reserve.mori` through `stage/{plan,cost,validate,admit,decode,digest}.rs` and `runtime::run_segment` confirms segment costs (`[5, 6]` total 11 for escrow; `[11, 15, 10]` total 36 for reserve), prefix-monotone captures, false-guard non-advancing resume invariance, and suffix rejection without partial effects.

Cargo Configuration Lookup & Cache Isolation: Cross-checking `PROPOSAL.md` against the targeted configuration lookup and cache structure sections of `docs/config.txt` and `docs/cargo-home.txt` confirms that Cargo probes `.cargo/config.toml` and `.cargo/config` from the invocation `cwd` up its ancestor chain (`/tmp/doctorwatson-core-check-*/cwd` -> `/tmp/doctorwatson-core-check-*` -> `/tmp` -> `/`) and then `$CARGO_HOME`. By running from an empty tempdir `cwd` after metadata-verifying the absence of `/tmp/.cargo/config{.toml,}` and `/.cargo/config{.toml,}`, and setting `CARGO_HOME` to a fresh directory containing only symlinks to `registry` and `git` (no `config.toml`, `config`, or `credentials.toml`) with a strict whitelisted environment (no `HOME`, `RUSTFLAGS`, `LD_PRELOAD`, wrappers, or target runners), user/host Cargo configs and private proof/key/SRS caches are excluded.

Resource & Concurrency Envelope: The single-child argv under `/usr/bin/timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=5s 30s` with `--frozen -j1`, `CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true`, `CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0`, `CARGO_CACHE_AUTO_CLEAN_FREQUENCY=never`, and `-- --test-threads=1` enforces single-job compilation, single-threaded test execution, offline operation, and a hard 30s+5s wall-clock ceiling with one attempt and no automatic retry.

Execution Conditions: (1) All pending source/oracle reviews (including financial-v2) must complete with zero changed relevant bytes, and the target checkout `/home/charl/Moriarty/.worktrees/utxo-main-merge-20261017` must match the reviewed `candidate/` tree (`33a39221d279f6feba518bc2184b526056ce3071`) before the single attempt runs; (2) metadata-only absence checks for `/tmp/.cargo/{config,config.toml}` and `/.cargo/{config,config.toml}` (and absence of `.cargo/{config,config.toml}` in the target checkout root) must pass immediately prior to invocation; (3) Opus security owner must separately classify and admit the command, including Cargo's standard read/write locking and `.crate` unpacking behavior on the symlinked `/home/charl/.cargo/{registry,git}` caches under `--frozen`.
limitations: Source-only review: no shell, Cargo, rustc, test, SDK, native, VM, crypto, key, wallet, ledger, network, private config, or cache access was performed.

Scope of verdict: `approve-exact-ordinary-proposal` represents ordinary source/design and resource-envelope agreement only; security classification, cache-mutation admission, and execution authority rest separately with Opus.

Cold-build timeout risk: compiling the `mori-core` crate graph and proc-macro dependencies from scratch in an empty `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` with `-j1` may exceed the 30s wall-clock cap; per the proposal, a timeout is a recorded failure and does not authorize retries or budget increases.

Compiler and cache trust assumption: relies on the named assumption that the local rustup 1.99.0 toolchain binaries (`cargo`, `rustc`, `rustdoc`) and cached crates.io/git sources in `/home/charl/.cargo/{registry,git}` are ordinary upstream artifacts (not independently audited or binary-authenticated in this review).

Bounded semantic claim: passing `continuations` and `financial_pair` tests establishes only finite local `moriarty-core/1` financial projection and `moriarty-core/2` staged continuation behavior on the tested fixtures, not Midnight native/circuit/ledger settlement or full U2 qualification.
